notes.title: Legend of Nazera V1.2
notes.notes:
I know it's been a long time since the last update but I've been so busy with work and life!
I plan on working more on this game in my free time (sadly I only get up to an hour a day most days.)
But onto the update.

[h1]Quick update information[/h1]
I have changed the UI to now show you your abilities and have a new way of showing you the upgrade is available.
[list]
[*] This was done due to a lot of people not even knowing about the upgrade area or abilities.
[/list]

I also added a new system to hold the upgrade system. We now have a level system to track what upgrades are available that is tied to the way that the character plays the game.
[list]
[*]I am still working on this feature and it's balance but it makes balancing the energy a lot better.
[*]This does mean that the energy generation is a lot slower than it was before this update.
[/list]

[h1]Character Playstyles[/h1]
So starting with this update I wanted to lock in character playstyle archetypes.

[h2]Armigog (Rushdown/Brawler)[/h2]
His style of gameplay will reward taking down your enemy as quickly as possible. He gains meter and bonus experience based on units that fall in combat. His base units are relatively cheap and easy to summon but his stronger units take more gold to summon but can reward the player with more reliable damage. His top ability also summons a powerful unit, himself, to fight on the field and increase the potency of all of his abilities.

[h2]Ambrose (SpellCaster)[/h2]
Her playstyle is more focused on taking your time and using your abilities to wear down your enemies. In game you see this as she gains meter over time and gains experience faster overtime. Her abilities are incredibly powerful but her units aren't as strong (either in health or in attack power). Managing your meter and the units you have on the field are crucial to her success.

[h2]Nirxul (Summoner)[/h2]
Their playstyle feels initially similar to Rushdown but is purely about summoning as many units as possible. The main units to summon are relatively weak but useful to keep you from losing quickly. As time goes on and you gain more footing your more expensive units can prove to be more troublesome to your opponent. When playing this character you gain meter based on the units you summon and your abilities can do solid aoe to give you a strong late game pushing force. 

[h2]The other characters[/h2]
I am working on getting them inline based on how these 3 end up playing feelling and balancing. I want to make other archetypes but getting the base ones down is the best thing to start off with to ensure I don't have too much balance bloat early on and have to redo work. 

I have a lot more planned to make this game better and this was just the start.
The next things I plan on working on is the way the hero's go in and make the use of abilities more interesting and game changing, without breaking the balance of the game of course.

notes.title: We are still working!
notes.notes:
Hello I want to let you guys know we have a Kickstarter up for our card game, Knights of the Real Estate! This game is actually older than legend of Nazera and some friends have been wanting me to publish this game so we are working to get some funding for the production of the game. You can find our [url=http://kck.st/3N0XKa4]Kickstarter here[/url].
While we are working on this we are planning a revamp to the game mechanics to make them more fun and can't wait to show you guys what we plan on doing. Right now we are running with 1 dev for the rebuild and want to find a few more people that want to jump on to help us get this off the ground. Thank you everyone that has purchased this game so far.

notes.title: Legend of Nazera V 1.1
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience. I know it has been a while but I'm still working on this game!
After this build, I plan on doing a big overhaul on some of the mechanics but;
1. I need feedback on some of the current workings of the game.
2. I like getting ideas from people who have played the game.
I know I could have waited for the overhaul after but I wanted everyone to see what has already been changed.
Please leave any feedback you have here at https://forms.gle/Ms6GcSGzz25D3oCF9 and follow us on all social media @coggnLLC or Coalition of Gamers Geeks and Nerds!


This update was pretty big on the back end.
All of the characters have been rebalanced to push for the player to upgrade their tower while they play.
Some characters that are super strong I have toned down through upgrade or ability use costs.
Some characters have seen a power loss due to being way too strong.
A new level has been added that has you face off our first attempt at a boss battle.
The camera has been updated to feel better across all levels.
Some levels have been updated to look better with the new camera angles.
The end-of-game menu has been updated with new text options that are a lot clearer.
Though it was intended only for developers I kept it in the test levels so that you can try to face off against each of the heroes and use all of the ones that I have in the game.

notes.title: Update on development of the game
notes.notes:
I've been working on a lot of different things to make the game more enjoyable for you guys. I have updated character animation speeds, stats, character abilities, and even the character select screen. Once I release the next build I will post up all of the changes that I have remembered that I added and tested made sure was working in a way that works for the game.
Small insight on what has changed.
Armigog attacks faster now.
Nirxul can't cause massive lag spikes in the game.
Hardware raytracing is being axed, really expensive on some computers.
Everyone is getting a cost to stat rebalancing.
Also If you haven't already, Tell your friends about the game. as them to wishlist it! it really helps let us and steam know that people are interested in this game. With enough interest I should be able to finish up the story get an artist to make some meshes and push forward with the game. Thank you guys for your time.
